label: Wildlife Documentary
description: Documentary formula: subject x behavior x habitat through long glass and patient light.
prefix: An award-caliber wildlife documentary photograph — the kind that closes a nature magazine's year. A wild animal, utterly unaware of the camera, caught in a moment biologists wait weeks for.
suffix: Field Rendering: authentic unstaged conditions, (feather and fur detail individually resolved:1.2), (a crisp catchlight in the eye:1.25), background compressed into a painterly wash, the animal's full attention on its world — never on us.
negative: watermark, text, cartoon, anthropomorphic, deformed anatomy, zoo fences
